messages:
maria_support: FYI ACME just escalated — after last night's canary->prod traffic swap their payment tool calls are being invoked but the "metadata" field is empty/truncated. They started failing on our webhook with 400.
acme_integration: we rolled at 2026-03-16T02:15Z. samples attached, small payloads fine but anything with a metadata JSON > 120 bytes gets cut off. example:
```
{"amount":100,"metadata":"{\"customer_id\":\"cust_123\",\"order_id\":\"ord_9876\",\"notes\":\"...long...\"}"
}
```
maria_support: error from customer webhook:
```
400 Bad Request - invalid metadata: unexpected end of JSON
```
alex_runtime: looking at logs — runtime shows tool dispatch with args serialized, but I see KV cache path using streaming encoders for batched requests. suspect new streaming encoder truncates nested strings when buffer splits. pinging @sam_oncall to help repro locally.
sam_oncall: can repro locally with a quick curl. steps:
1) POST to our /v1/invoke with model=redwood-x and tool payment_webhook
2) payload with metadata ~200 chars
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-x","tool":"payment_webhook","input":{"amount":1,"metadata":"<200-char json>"}}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke
I see in the agent logs payload arriving as truncated at ~128 chars.
ben_prodeng: do we have a rollout id for last night? ops-bot, can you print rollout metadata.
ops-bot: rollout-bot: rollout "canary-traffic-swap-2026-03-16" completed at 2026-03-16T02:18Z, 100% traffic after 02:45Z. change list: runtime: enable streaming-batcher v2 for sequence batching
alex_runtime: pretty sure it's streaming-batcher v2 change. quick mitigation: revert that flag for ACME's tenant or enforce non-streaming path for toolcall serialization. i'll prepare a patch to guard against partial-string emit.
maria_support: ACME wants a hotfix or revert ASAP. they've started to see production errors in retries.
alex_runtime: creating a canary revert now and a unit test for long nested string fields. I'll open PR and link here.
alex_runtime: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4287 (draft) — adding tests + fallback to buffered encode when nested strings exceed 128 bytes.
sam_oncall: for support repro, attaching a short trace snippet showing truncated args:
```
[dispatch] tool=payment_webhook args="{...metadata:\"{\\\"customer_id\\\":\\\"cust_123\\\",\\\"order_id\\\":\\\"ord_9876\\\",\\\"notes\\\":\\\"...\"}..."}...
```
ben_prodeng: action items: 1) revert flag for ACME tenant (maria_support) 2) deploy patch to canary and run regression 3) notify customer with ETA
maria_support: I'll tell ACME we're reverting their flag now and will follow up with timeline. keeping thread updated :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag revert for tenant acme (flag streaming-batcher-v2=false) scheduled, job id ff-77321
maria_support: thanks all — please ping when patch is merged so I can confirm with ACME. 
acme_integration: thanks, any ETA? customers are seeing declined payments.
alex_runtime: ETA for hotfix: 3 hours to revert + 6 hours to validate then schedule patch. will update if faster.
sam_oncall: adding unit/regression test to CI now. next steps listed in PR.
ben_prodeng: opened internal incident INC-2026-311 with links to logs and this thread.
maria_support: keeping ACME on the line, will escalate to SE if needed.
